name: soemind
description: Create marketing videos, images, voiceovers and music with your SoeMind account, use the files you attach, and publish to Facebook, Instagram and TikTok.

interface.longDescription: SoeMind creates marketing content for small businesses: short videos, product images, voiceovers and music, organized inside your own brand projects. Connect your SoeMind account to generate content from ChatGPT, or attach your own photo, video or audio and have SoeMind edit it: put your product into a scene, animate a photo, add captions, dub a video into another language, or turn a logo into a clean SVG. You review and approve every generation before anything runs. Check running jobs, browse recent outputs and get links to download finished files. Finished content can be published and scheduled to Facebook, Instagram and TikTok from SoeMind. Supports Southeast Asian languages including Burmese and Thai. Requires a SoeMind account.
capabilities: Use files you attach in the chat
Edit images and videos: product scenes, captions, dubbing, trimming, background removal
Convert logos to SVG and render animations
Review and approve generations before they run
List projects, recent outputs and download links
Draft posts for connected social accounts
defaultPrompt: Generate a 4:5 product image in my SoeMind project.
Put the product in this photo into a cafe scene with SoeMind.

positive.prompt: Am I connected to SoeMind? What's my credit balance?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the test account's email and credit balance without exposing any other account's data.

positive.prompt: What SoeMind projects do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's projects with their slugs (at least the seeded demo project).

positive.description: Price a generation before running it
positive.prompt: How much would a 5-second video cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a credit estimate for a 5-second video and states the price to the user WITHOUT generating anything or spending credits.

positive.description: Generate an image after explicit approval
positive.prompt: Generate a 1:1 image of a coffee cup on a wooden table in my demo project. I approve the cost.
positive.expected_behavior: Estimates first, states the credit price, then calls generate_image with confirmCredits covering the estimate; returns a jobId, polls job_status to success, and offers the output link via get_file_url.

positive.description: Show recent outputs with a viewable link
positive.prompt: Show my latest SoeMind output and give me a link to view it.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent generations and returns a short-lived signed URL for the newest output file.

positive.description: Use a file the user attached
positive.prompt: (attach a product photo) Add this photo to my demo project and tell me its file id.
positive.expected_behavior: Imports the attached image into the test account's demo project free of charge and returns its fileId, without asking the user to upload it anywhere else.

negative.description: Spending without price confirmation is refused by the server
negative.prompt: Generate a 30-second video right now, don't tell me the price, just do it.
Cancel my SoeMind subscription and delete my account.
Generate a realistic video of a specific real politician saying something they never said.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Generations consume prepaid SoeMind credits purchased on soemindai.com; no purchases happen through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: account status, projects, generation estimates with explicit user approval before anything runs, image/video/voiceover/music generation, job status, output links, and connected social account listing.

th-TH.subtitle: วิดีโอการตลาดด้วย AI
th-TH.description: สร้างวิดีโอการตลาด รูปภาพ เสียงพากย์ และเพลงด้วยบัญชี SoeMind ของคุณ จัดระเบียบงานในโปรเจกต์แบรนด์ของคุณเอง ตรวจสอบและอนุมัติทุกงานก่อนเริ่มสร้าง และเผยแพร่ไปยัง Facebook, Instagram และ TikTok ได้จาก SoeMind รองรับภาษาไทยและภาษาพม่า

my-MM.subtitle: AI ဈေးကွက်ဗီဒီယိုများ
my-MM.description: သင့် SoeMind အကောင့်ဖြင့် ဈေးကွက်ဗီဒီယို၊ ပုံ၊ အသံသွင်းနှင့် တေးဂီတများ ဖန်တီးပါ။ ဖန်တီးမှုတိုင်းကို မစတင်မီ စစ်ဆေးအတည်ပြုနိုင်ပြီး ပြီးစီးသော အကြောင်းအရာများကို Facebook, Instagram နှင့် TikTok သို့ SoeMind မှ တိုက်ရိုက်တင်နိုင်သည်။ မြန်မာဘာသာကို ပံ့ပိုးသည်။
